# LIBRARIES
```{r}
install.packages("schoRsch")
install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("ez")
library(schoRsch)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ez)
```


# 2. SPATIAL STROOP
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
which_dat = "spatialStroopSOA-repl.xlsx"
stroop_data = readxl::read_excel(which_dat)
```

# pre_processing
```{r}
stroop_data$prev_Congruency = dplyr::lag(stroop_data$Congruency)
stroop_data$prev_Accuracy = dplyr::lag(stroop_data$Accuracy)

# data filtering
filtered_data = stroop_data[stroop_data$RT >= 200 & stroop_data$RT <= 1500,]

# filtering out trials - they sure do have an explanation for this lol
processed_data = filtered_data[!(filtered_data$`Trial Number` %in% c(1, 121, 241, 361, 481, 601, 721, 841)),]

# only correct trials
processed_data = processed_data %>% 
  filter(Accuracy == 1, 
         prev_Accuracy == 1)
```


## ANOVA
```{r}
processed_data$Participant = as.factor(processed_data$Participant)
processed_data$Congruency = as.factor(processed_data$Congruency)
processed_data$prev_Congruency = as.factor(processed_data$prev_Congruency)
processed_data$SOA = as.factor(processed_data$SOA)

aov.rt = ezANOVA(processed_data,
                 dv = RT,
                 wid = Participant,
                 within = .(Congruency, prev_Congruency, SOA),
                 detailed = TRUE,
                 return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.rt)

```

## Post-hoc analyses
```{r}
library(broom)
cong_data<-subset(processed_data, Congruency == 1)
aov.cong = ezANOVA(cong_data,dv = RT,
                  wid = Participant,
                  within = .(prev_Congruency),
                  detailed = TRUE,
                  return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.cong)

incong_data<-subset(processed_data, Congruency == 0)
aov.incong = ezANOVA(incong_data,dv = RT,
                   wid = Participant,
                   within = .(prev_Congruency),
                   detailed = TRUE,
                   return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.incong)

k_data<-subset(processed_data, SOA == -100 | SOA == -50)
aov.k = ezANOVA(k_data,dv = RT,
                   wid = Participant,
                   within = .(prev_Congruency, Congruency),
                   detailed = TRUE,
                   return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.k)
```


## Mean error rates for experimental conditions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
data = read_excel("spatialStroopSOA-repl.xlsx")
names(data)[2] = "TrialNum"
```


## calculate variables
```{r}
data$n1Accuracy = lag(data$Accuracy, 1)
data$n1Congruency = lag(data$Congruency, 1)
data$n1ArrowNum = lag(data$ArrowNum, 1)
firsttrials = c(0:7)*120+1
```

## exclude trials
```{r}
fdata = data %>%
  filter(!(TrialNum%in%firsttrials), RT >= 200, RT <= 1500)

gdata <- data.frame(Congruency=fdata$Congruency, 
                    n1Congruency=fdata$n1Congruency,
                    SOA=fdata$SOA,
                    Accuracy=fdata$Accuracy)

gdata %>% group_by(Congruency,n1Congruency,SOA) %>% summarise (x = mean(Accuracy))
```
